text:
Everyone says AI agents can shop for you now. So I tested it.

Same message to ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude: "Buy me the cheapest Apple 20W USB-C charger on Amazon and get it delivered to me. Do it all yourself." One try each.

ChatGPT found a listing, then said "I won't pretend it's purchased when it isn't." Gemini said it cannot place orders. Claude said it has no browser and no access to an Amazon account. None of them opened the store.

The agents that really shop, like Chrome's auto browse, are built to stop and ask before they pay. And last week, big US banks said they are limiting AI agents that log in with a customer's password (CBS News, 22 Oct 2026).

Would you let an AI pay for you?
